_doc: Referee round, step 1 (referee-adjudication skill): one referee per scope reads the whole frozen snapshot and
reports on its scope. The report is saved as <workdir>/<unit>/referee/report.md and must end with the line
'Suggestions: N', which adjudication_summary.py --expect uses. Then run rollout.adjudication.example.json.
Profile 'referee': add it to your agents file, e.g. {"extends": "reviewer", "model": "<referee model>"}, a
model family other than the writers'. The Yang-Mills campaign (2026) used three referees with these three
scopes. Copy this file to <working repository>/rollout/, replace every SET-ME value, run

vars.snapshot: SET-ME: the frozen snapshot of the whole draft (make_packet.py): main.pdf and every source file
vars.paper: a natural-language proof, written by AI agents, of the theorem of a completed Lean development
vars.reader: an expert in the field of the result, checking each step with pen and paper

vars.scope: Part I: the abstract and Sections 1-9
